verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents an explicit `skills update` command. It can update all installed skills, a single skill by name, or several named skills, and its stated purpose is to 'update skills to latest versions' (gh-13, gh-26, gh-42, docs-9, docs-21). The recommended symlink install mode is described as a single source of truth for easy updates (gh-38), and the lockfile restore (docs-22) supports reproducible reinstalls. Community complaints that update paths are undocumented (comm-10, comm-11) are general skepticism without a concrete failure, and the current docs contradict them, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that `skills update` works, and documentation of how 'latest' is resolved (version or ref pinning semantics).
